scope: Author-approved local portrait rollout; illustration pools do not alter recorded sex, age or game rules.

source.name: Character portrait kit
source.creator: Dezra's Dragons
source.original_embedded_notices: No supplied text/creator/license chunks; source-page creator/profile notice is retained separately.

original_license.cells: Baby/child/neutral/unknown-age faces and modern frame rails are manually authored original pixel work; no kit imagery is copied into original cells.

model.continuity: The exact same skin/hair RGB families remain ID-bound across every age and sex pool. No gray-hair aging substitution. Unknown sex selects neutral; unknown age selects faceless age-indeterminate cells.
model.scaling: 64px cells and scenery use the same positive integer source-pixel scale; no fractional resampling.

method: Manual integer-pixel composition through Pillow. Template crop rectangles, exact palette replacements, masked/unmasked drawing commands and frame rails plus per-cell RGBA hashes fully specify modifications. No generation, network, model, random choice, source resampling or preview/comment art.
